title: Implemented Gemini Cross-Tool Learnings
description:
Implemented all 4 recommendations from Gemini session analysis:

1. **WAI-AI-ONBOARDING.md** - Consolidated AI reference document with:
   - AI Interaction Model (WAI commands as directives, not shell)
   - Complete command reference
   - Session start protocol
   - Lug interpretation guide
   - Common patterns and examples
   - Cross-tool compatibility notes

2. **WAI-VERSION-GUIDE.md** - Clarified versioning scheme:
   - wheelwright.version (framework features)
   - structure_version (directory layout)
   - WAI_WORKSPACE_VERSION (workspace compatibility)
   - upgrade_plan_version (teaching schema)
   - Decision trees for which version to check when
   - Compatibility matrix and rules

3. **WAI-MERGE-PROTOCOLS.md** - Complex JSON merge guidance:
   - Deep merge algorithm (AI-interpretable pseudo-code)
   - Preservation rules (timestamps, IDs, runtime state)
   - Conflict resolution decision tree
   - Array merge strategies
   - Change logging requirements
   - Validation after merge

4. **GEMINI.md** - Gemini-specific integration file:
   - Session start protocol
   - Critical reminders (WAI commands as directives)
   - Lug system (use WAI-Lugs.jsonl, not wheel-signals.jsonl)
   - Session logging requirements
   - Teaching adoption workflow
   - File structure reference

**Scribe Project Fixes:**
- Migrated wheel-signals.jsonl → WAI-Lugs.jsonl
- Updated WAI-State.json to reference correct file
- Copied all new AI onboarding docs to reference/
- Installed GEMINI.md in project root
- Cleaned up outdated teaching files

**Impact:** Cross-tool AI collaboration now supported with consistent understanding of WAI framework. Gemini, Claude, and future AI tools can work on same projects without confusion.
resolution_reason: All 4 Gemini learning documents created and distributed
